concerns.text: The plan asserts that the baseline verifier (CPU‑only 8‑bit quantized Edit‑R1 1B) must run on the full 1 000‑prompt dataset within ≤ 2 hours on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM). Given the size of a 1 B‑parameter model even when 8‑bit quantized, and the limited CPU resources, this runtime budget is likely infeasible; typical inference speeds on such hardware would exceed the 2‑hour limit, risking violation of SC‑009.
